# pkc/util

> pkc helpers: string and vector utilities the compiler uses everywhere (prefix u_).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/util.pkg)

Small functions on top of `rt` that mirror the Go standard library calls
the reference compiler makes (`strings.TrimSpace`, `strings.Fields`,
`strconv.Atoi`, `strconv.Quote`, ...), so that `pkc` produces the same
results and error messages. Errors are reported through the global
`pk_err`: a failing function sets it and returns `null` or `false`.

## Needs

- [std](../std.md)
- [rt](../rt.md)

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
// pk_err holds the message of the most recent error.
global pk_err: str = ""

fn u_fail(msg: str) -> bool
  pk_err = msg
  return false
end

fn u_cat(a: str, b: str) -> str
  return str_concat(a, b)
end

fn u_cat3(a: str, b: str, c: str) -> str
  return str_concat(str_concat(a, b), c)
end

fn u_cat4(a: str, b: str, c: str, d: str) -> str
  return str_concat(str_concat(a, b), str_concat(c, d))
end

fn u_push(v: ptr Vec, s: str)
  vec_push(v, s as int)
end

fn u_get(v: ptr Vec, i: int) -> str
  return vec_get(v, i) as str
end

fn u_is_space(c: u8) -> bool
  return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == 11 as u8 || c == 12 as u8
end

fn u_trim(s: str) -> str
  let a = 0
  let b = len(s)
  while a < b && u_is_space(s[a])
    a = a + 1
  end
  while b > a && u_is_space(s[b - 1])
    b = b - 1
  end
  if a == 0 && b == len(s)
    return s
  end
  return str_slice(s, a, b)
end

fn u_rtrim_byte(s: str, c: u8) -> str
  let b = len(s)
  while b > 0 && s[b - 1] == c
    b = b - 1
  end
  return str_slice(s, 0, b)
end

// u_fields splits on runs of whitespace, like strings.Fields.
fn u_fields(s: str) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let i = 0
  while i < len(s)
    while i < len(s) && u_is_space(s[i])
      i = i + 1
    end
    let start = i
    while i < len(s) && !u_is_space(s[i])
      i = i + 1
    end
    if i > start
      u_push(out, str_slice(s, start, i))
    end
  end
  return out
end

fn u_split(s: str, c: u8) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let start = 0
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    if s[i] == c
      u_push(out, str_slice(s, start, i))
      start = i + 1
    end
  end
  u_push(out, str_slice(s, start, len(s)))
  return out
end

fn u_join(v: ptr Vec, sep: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(v) - 1
    if i > 0
      sb_add(b, sep)
    end
    sb_add(b, u_get(v, i))
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn u_join_from(v: ptr Vec, from: int, sep: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = from to vec_len(v) - 1
    if i > from
      sb_add(b, sep)
    end
    sb_add(b, u_get(v, i))
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn u_has(s: str, sub: str) -> bool
  return str_find(s, sub, 0) >= 0
end

fn u_replace(s: str, old: str, rep: str) -> str
  if len(old) == 0
    return s
  end
  let b = sb_new()
  let i = 0
  while true
    let j = str_find(s, old, i)
    if j < 0
      break
    end
    sb_add(b, str_slice(s, i, j))
    sb_add(b, rep)
    i = j + len(old)
  end
  sb_add(b, str_slice(s, i, len(s)))
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn u_after(s: str, prefix: str) -> str
  if str_starts(s, prefix)
    return str_slice(s, len(prefix), len(s))
  end
  return s
end

// u_atoi parses like strconv.Atoi: an optional sign, then digits.
fn u_atoi(s: str, ok: ptr bool) -> int
  if len(s) > 0 && s[0] == '+'
    return str_parse_int(str_slice(s, 1, len(s)), ok)
  end
  return str_parse_int(s, ok)
end

fn u_hex(b: ptr StrBuf, c: int)
  let digits = "0123456789abcdef"
  sb_byte(b, digits[(c >> 4) & 15])
  sb_byte(b, digits[c & 15])
end

// u_quote quotes like Go's %q for the strings the compiler meets: ASCII
// escapes, other bytes kept as UTF-8.
fn u_quote(s: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    let c = s[i]
    if c == '"'
      sb_add(b, "\\\"")
    elif c == '\\'
      sb_add(b, "\\\\")
    elif c == '\n'
      sb_add(b, "\\n")
    elif c == '\t'
      sb_add(b, "\\t")
    elif c == '\r'
      sb_add(b, "\\r")
    elif c < ' ' || c == 127 as u8
      sb_add(b, "\\x")
      u_hex(b, c as int)
    else
      sb_byte(b, c)
    end
  end
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn u_in(v: ptr Vec, s: str) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(v) - 1
    if u_get(v, i) == s
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

fn u_words(s: str) -> ptr Vec
  return u_fields(s)
end
```
